content: Intel’s operating loss for 2025 was **$10.3 billion**【Doc 2: INTC 10-K 0000050863-26-000011】. This figure is also reflected in the segment‑level financials, where the operating loss for the year ended December 27, 2025 was reported as **$10,318 million**【Doc 3: INTC 10‑K 0000050863‑26‑000011】.
